title: Hitchcock
description: Alma Reville lends her customary support to husband Alfred Hitchcock as he directs "Psycho," but her reservations about the film's production cause a strain in their marriage.

title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
description: In a Latin American prison, an emotional relationship evolves between a homosexual and his cellmate, a political radical.

title: Broken City
description: A former cop (Mark Wahlberg) becomes embroiled in a bigger scandal than he realized after being hired to tail the cheating wife of the mayor (Russell Crowe).

title: Colette
description: After moving to Paris, author Sidonie-Gabrielle Colette agrees to ghostwrite a semi-autobiographical novel for her husband. Its success soon inspires her to fight for creative ownership and overcome the societal constraints of the early 20th century.

title: Inconceivable
description: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter.

title: Magnolia
description: Coincidence, divine intervention and fate link several people (Jason Robards, Julianne Moore, Tom Cruise) on an intense day which becomes a moral odyssey.

title: Papillon
description: The epic story of Henri Papillon Charrière, framed for murder and condemned to life in the notorious penal colony on Devil's Island. Determined to regain his freedom, Papillon forms an alliance with counterfeiter Louis Dega to finance his escape.

title: Working Girls
description: A photographer (Louise Smith) and others work for a yuppie madam (Ellen McElduff) in a Manhattan brothel, then go home.

title: Ricochet
description: An escaped hit man (John Lithgow) seeks revenge on the policeman turned district attorney (Denzel Washington) who sent him to prison.

title: Shot Caller
description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang.

title: Sound of My Voice
description: Two documentary filmmakers (Christopher Denham, Nicole Vicius) set out to expose a cult, but they fall under the control of its charismatic leader (Brit Marling) instead.

title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
description: Family tensions arise after a woman (Nia Vardalos) falls in love with a man (John Corbett) who is not Greek.

title: Beasts of the Southern Wild
description: The father of an intrepid youngster (Quvenzhané Wallis) prepares her for the end of the world, when melting ice caps release fearsome beasts, called aurochs, and rising floodwaters threaten to engulf their Delta home.

title: Fantastic Planet
description: The 39-foot-tall pastel Draags keep leashes on the Oms, their tiny pets descended from humans.

title: Love, Simon
description: Teenager Simon Spier hasn't told his family or friends that he's gay, and he doesn't know the identity of the anonymous classmate that he's fallen for online. Resolving both issues proves hilarious, terrifying and life-changing.

title: Friendship
description: A suburban dad falls hard for his new neighbor.

title: Mid90s
description: In the 1990s Los Angeles, a 13-year-old spends his summer navigating between a troubled home life and a crew of new friends he meets at a skate shop.

title: Mississippi Masala
description: People resent the romance of a black man (Denzel Washington) and an Indian woman (Sarita Choudhury) in a Mississippi town.

title: The Post
description: In 1971, publisher Katharine Graham and editor Ben Bradlee of The Washington Post risk their careers and very freedom to expose a massive cover-up of government secrets that spans three decades and four U.S. presidents.

title: Hidden Figures
description: NASA mathematicians Katherine Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson cross gender and race lines to help launch astronaut John Glenn into outer space.

title: Brian Banks
description: The true story of Brian Banks, a high school football player who faces prison for a crime he didn't commit. Years later, with the support of the California Innocence Project, Banks fights to reclaim his life and fulfill his dreams of NFL stardom.

title: Queer
description: Lee, a solitary American in Mexico City, falls for a beautiful, elusive former soldier. Journeying together into the jungle, Lee sees, for the first time, the possibility of an intimate and infinite love.

title: Due Date
description: Desperate to reach his pregnant wife (Michelle Monaghan), a high-strung architect (Robert Downey Jr.) takes a road trip home with an annoying stranger (Zach Galifianakis).

title: Adult Best Friends
description: Katie takes her best friend on a nostalgic trip to their hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests.

title: Women Is Losers
description: Celina Guerrero attempts to rise above poverty in the 1960s San Francisco.

title: Super Troopers 2
description: Former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption in Canada. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties and a smuggling ring.

title: The Man
description: A case of mistaken identity leaves an ATF agent (Samuel L. Jackson) squabbling with a talkative salesman (Eugene Levy) in his custody.

title: It's Complicated
description: A restaurateur (Meryl Streep) falls into an affair with her remarried ex-husband (Alec Baldwin), while an architect (Steve Martin) that she hired to refurbish her kitchen falls in love with her.

title: The Daytrippers
description: Family members (Pat McNamara, Anne Meara) join a woman (Hope Davis) on an odyssey to confront her husband about a love letter addressed to him.

title: The Art of Getting By
description: A high-school senior (Freddie Highmore) has a fatalistic outlook on life but slowly starts to change his view after meeting a free-spirited classmate (Emma Roberts).

title: Lord of the Flies
description: English schoolboys (James Aubrey, Tom Chapin, Hugh Edwards), stranded on a desert island without adults, soon turn savage.

title: Isle of Dogs
description: In the future, an outbreak of canine flu leads the mayor of a Japanese city to banish all dogs to an island that's a garbage dump. The outcasts must soon embark on an epic journey when a 12-year-old boy arrives on the island to find his beloved pet.

title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
description: Agent Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) comes to Twin Peaks, Wash., following two unresolved murders and the disappearance of two fellow agents.

title: War for the Planet of the Apes
description: A ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson) leads his troops in a deadly battle against Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his army of intelligent apes.

title: Repo Men
description: Set in the future when artificial organs can be bought on credit, a man struggles to make the payments on a heart he has purchased. He must go on the run before the heart is repossessed.

title: Smoking Tigers
description: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends.

title: Walkabout
description: A lost teenager (Jenny Agutter) and her little brother (Lucien John) meet an Aboriginal teen (David Gulpilil) in the Outback.

title: The Craft
description: Teen misfits befriend a suicidal newcomer and strike back at their tormentors with witchcraft in Los Angeles.

title: Christmas With the Kranks
description: A Chicago couple scramble to put together a holiday celebration after their daughter decides to come home for Christmas.

title: Pan
description: Living a bleak existence at a London orphanage, 12-year-old Peter finds himself whisked away to the fantastical world of Neverland. With the turn of events, soon he has to save Neverland from the pirate Blackbeard.

title: A Hard Day's Night
description: John, Paul, George and Ringo (The Beatles) spend 36 wild hours in London, besieged by exuberant fans.

title: King's Ransom
description: An obnoxious businessman (Anthony Anderson) arranges his own kidnapping to foil his wife's (Kellita Smith) impending divorce settlement.

title: Maze Runner: The Death Cure
description: Thomas leads some escaped Gladers on their final and most dangerous mission yet. To save their friends, they must break into the legendary Last City, a WCKD-controlled labyrinth that may turn out to be the deadliest maze of all.

title: Aftermath
description: Two strangers' lives become inextricably bound together after an error by an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy) causes the death of a construction foreman's (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wife and daughter.

title: Eyes Wide Shut
description: A doctor (Tom Cruise) explores his relationship with his wife (Nicole Kidman) by delving into a sensual underworld.

title: The Last Samurai
description: In the 1870s a Westerner is caught in the middle of a battle between Japan's emperor and the samurai.

title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
description: After a 50-year-old woman's (Frances McDormand) daughter is murdered, she confronts the police (Caleb Landry Jones, Kerry Condon) in her town, using the billboards on the outskirts of town to begin a smear campaign against them.
